cohort: 149 parturients who underwent cesarean section (CS) between July 2018 and July 2021
finding: Lactation prescription plus acupoint stimulation was associated with improved breastfeeding quality, reduced breast tenderness, and higher neonatal weight at 42 days postpartum in parturients after CS.
mod_finding: This study examined the effects of lactation prescription plus acupoint stimulation on breastfeeding quality and breast tenderness in parturients after cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight at 42 days postpartum was recorded
